messages:
incidents-bot: ALERT: spike in 5xx errors for /v1/generate (us-west-2). 90s window, error rate ~18%. Paging on-call.
mike_sre: I’m on it. pulling metrics and logs now.
sara_eng: seeing customer-facing latencies too, some requests timing out at 10s then 502. Which runner pool?
mike_sre: starts: `pool=model-runner-usw2-a`, autoscaler not triggering yet. Running `kubectl get pods -n inference -l pool=model-runner-usw2-a` shows 10/15 pods Ready.
ops-bot: New alert: pod model-runner-7c9d crashed with SIGSEGV. Crashloop backoff on 3 nodes.
jules_ml: that SIGSEGV aligns with yesterday's quant-kernel change? We rolled q8 kernels to canary last night in that pool.
alex_platform: I am removing canary label from deployment now to stop new pods getting the build. `kubectl patch deployment model-runner --type=json -p '[{"op":"remove","path":"/spec/template/metadata/labels/canary"}]'`
emma_support: major customers A and B reporting elevated errors, logging ticket for both. ETA to mitigation?
mike_sre: immediate step: cordon the 3 nodes with recent canary pods and drain them. rerouting traffic via gateway to other pools. running `kubectl drain node-az2-07 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`.
sara_eng: quick check logs from a crashed pod:
```
2026-03-17T21:04:12Z model-runner[pid:42] ERROR: Segmentation fault at 0x7ffdeadbeef
Stacktrace:
  #0 0x55a1b3 kernel_quant::dispatch()
  #1 0x55a1d0 runner::forward()
  #2 0x55b2c1 main
Killed by SIGSEGV
OOM? no, mem usage peaked then reduced.
```
jules_ml: that stacktrace lands inside the new attention path. rolling it back is needed. do we have a stable image tag to force?
alex_platform: yes `model-runner:2026-03-15-stable`. triggering a rollout to that tag in the affected deployment: `kubectl set image deployment/model-runner model-runner=ghcr.io/redwood/model-runner:2026-03-15-stable -n inference`.
ops-bot: Rollout started. 5 pods updated -> 0/5 ready (starting)
mike_sre: meanwhile enabling fallback routing at gateway: `gatewayctl set-route /v1/generate fallback-model=small-embed-usw2` to reduce load on heavy runners.
emma_support: notified customers A/B: we’ve applied traffic reroute and rollback; they see partial improvement.
sara_eng: also discovered a scheduling pressure: some nodes show GPU OOM evictions on older kernels; raising cluster capacity as precaution: `k scale nodepool gpu-high --replicas=5 -> 7`.
mike_sre: after rollback, new pods come up healthy. error rate dropped to ~2% in 3 minutes.
jules_ml: follow-up: create revert PR for quant-kernel change and add integration test hitting long context paths.
emma_support: filing incident postmortem with customer impact notes: impacted window ~21:03-21:12 PDT, affected 1.4% of requests, key customers partially impacted.
alex_platform: schedule hotpatch backfill for canary gating and add crash-collector on segfault to capture cores: `systemctl enable core-collector`.
incidents-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: error rate back to baseline. Please update runbook if you did steps outside it.

Note: logs and commands above are redacted for PII. Thread closed after follow-ups.
